examples.en: Our career fair attracted a host of local employers this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天，我们的招聘会吸引了许多本地雇主。

examples.en: Before boarding, Mia took a test for COVID-19 at the airport.
examples.zh: 登机前，米娅在机场做了新冠病毒检测。

examples.en: Tomorrow our chemistry class will conduct a test on river water.
examples.zh: 明天我们的化学课将对河水进行检测。

examples.en: To check the battery, the mechanic ran a test with a small meter.
examples.zh: 为了检查电池，机械师用一个小仪表进行了测试。

examples.en: Above all, remember to keep your passport in a safe place.
examples.zh: 最重要的是，记得把护照放在安全的地方。

examples.en: According to the campus notice, the library will close at nine.
examples.zh: 根据校园通知，图书馆将在九点关门。

examples.en: By adjusting food production to demand, the market may achieve equilibrium.
examples.zh: 通过使食品产量适应需求，市场可能达到平衡。

examples.en: Although the route was longer, the guide achieved her purpose of avoiding traffic.
examples.zh: 尽管路线更长，导游还是达到了避开拥堵的目的。

examples.en: With steady practice, even a shy speaker can achieve success.
examples.zh: 通过持续练习，即使害羞的演讲者也能取得成功。

examples.en: Only by trusting one another did the volleyball team achieve victory.
examples.zh: 排球队只有相互信任才取得了胜利。

meaning: 遵照...行动，作用于；对...有影响

examples.en: Once the doctor received the results, she acted on them immediately.
examples.zh: 医生一收到检查结果，就立即据此采取了行动。

examples.en: Rent, transport, and meals add up to most of my monthly spending.
examples.zh: 房租、交通和吃饭的费用加起来占了我每月开支的大部分。

examples.en: Could you add my name to the list of weekend volunteers?
examples.zh: 你能把我的名字加到周末志愿者名单里吗？

examples.en: Every visitor must adhere to the museum rules on photography.
examples.zh: 每位游客都必须遵守博物馆的摄影规定。

examples.en: Let us invite Leo; after all, he helped organize the picnic.
examples.zh: 我们邀请利奥吧，毕竟他帮忙组织了这次野餐。

examples.en: After an hour of discussion, the roommates agreed on a cleaning schedule.
examples.zh: 经过一小时的讨论，室友们就清洁安排达成了一致。

examples.en: My landlord agreed to repair the broken heater before Friday.
examples.zh: 房东同意在星期五之前修好坏掉的暖气。

examples.en: On this point, I agree with our history teacher.
examples.zh: 在这一点上，我同意历史老师的看法。

examples.en: Along with her laptop, Nina packed a paper notebook for the trip.
examples.zh: 除了笔记本电脑，尼娜还为旅行带上了一个纸质笔记本。

examples.en: During the workshop, short lectures alternate with practical activities.
examples.zh: 研讨班期间，简短讲座与实践活动交替进行。

examples.en: The damage to the rented bicycle amounted to two hundred yuan.
examples.zh: 租来的自行车的损坏赔偿总计两百元。

meaning: 与...相当的人/物，(地位)相同的人

examples.en: After years of training, no one in the club was an equal to Chen in chess.
examples.zh: 经过多年训练，俱乐部里没有人在国际象棋方面能与陈匹敌。

examples.en: The room looked tiny, and yet it held everything I needed.
examples.zh: 房间看起来很小，然而它容纳了我需要的一切。

examples.en: Despite the bright advertisement, the new phone was anything but cheap.
examples.zh: 尽管广告很亮眼，这款新手机一点也不便宜。

examples.en: Does the online photograph look anything like the actual hotel room?
examples.zh: 网上的照片看起来和真实的酒店房间像吗？

examples.en: My first drawing was not anywhere near as good as my sister’s.
examples.zh: 我的第一幅画远没有姐姐的画得好。

examples.en: Apart from taking classes, Sam works evenings at the campus café.
examples.zh: 除了上课，萨姆晚上还在校园咖啡馆工作。

examples.en: The discount applies to students who travel during the winter break.
examples.zh: 这项折扣适用于寒假期间出行的学生。

examples.en: Reading poetry gave the engineering student a new appreciation of language.
examples.zh: 阅读诗歌使这名工科学生对语言有了新的认识。

examples.en: Several residents argued against building a car park beside the lake.
examples.zh: 几位居民提出理由反对在湖边建停车场。

examples.en: As a result of heavy snow, all flights from the city were delayed.
examples.zh: 由于大雪，所有从这座城市起飞的航班都延误了。

meaning: 作为结果，因此；表结果，用不用逗号隔开看情况而定；

examples.en: Lena missed the last bus; as a result, she walked home.
examples.zh: 莉娜错过了末班车，因此她步行回了家。

meaning: 作为一个整体，整个看来

examples.en: The class as a whole responded warmly to the exchange student.
examples.zh: 全班同学总体上都热情地接纳了这名交换生。

examples.en: As far as new students are concerned, clear directions are especially helpful.
examples.zh: 对新生而言，清楚的指引尤其有帮助。

examples.en: As for dinner, we can try the noodle shop across the street.
examples.zh: 至于晚饭，我们可以试试街对面的面馆。

examples.en: The child stared at the robot as if it were alive.
examples.zh: 那个孩子盯着机器人，仿佛它是活的一样。

examples.en: Please text me as soon as your train reaches Hangzhou.
examples.zh: 你的火车一到杭州就请给我发消息。

examples.en: Clouds covered the hills as though a storm were approaching.
examples.zh: 乌云笼罩着群山，仿佛暴风雨即将来临。

examples.en: There is still some doubt as to whether the old bridge is safe.
examples.zh: 关于这座旧桥是否安全，仍然存在一些疑问。

examples.en: The course teaches basic coding and offers career advice as well.
examples.zh: 这门课程教授基础编程，也提供职业建议。

examples.en: The missing museum ticket has not been found as yet.
examples.zh: 那张遗失的博物馆门票至今仍未找到。

examples.en: Aside from a sore throat, Jin felt well enough to attend class.
examples.zh: 除了嗓子疼，金感觉还不错，可以去上课。

examples.en: Many foreign visitors associate paper cutting with Chinese culture.
examples.zh: 许多外国游客把剪纸与中国文化联系在一起。

examples.en: Researchers found an association between regular walks and better sleep.
examples.zh: 研究人员发现，经常散步与更好的睡眠之间存在关联。

examples.en: Without reliable internet access, rural learners may be at a disadvantage.
examples.zh: 没有可靠的网络，农村学习者可能处于不利地位。

examples.en: When both paths disappeared in the fog, the hikers were at a loss.
examples.zh: 当两条路都消失在雾中时，徒步者们不知所措。

examples.en: The nurse asked us to enter the clinic one at a time.
examples.zh: 护士让我们一次一个地进入诊所。

examples.en: I did not recognize my primary school classmate at all.
examples.zh: 我完全没有认出我的小学同学。

examples.en: With those dark clouds overhead, rain could begin at any moment.
examples.zh: 头顶乌云密布，随时都可能下雨。

examples.en: At first, living away from home made the freshman nervous.
examples.zh: 起初，离家生活让这名大一新生很不安。

examples.en: The mayor promised to listen to the public at large.
examples.zh: 市长承诺听取广大公众的意见。

examples.en: After three failed attempts, our model plane flew at last.
examples.zh: 三次尝试失败后，我们的模型飞机终于飞起来了。

examples.en: Even if the meal is late, at least the ingredients are fresh.
examples.zh: 即使上菜晚了，至少食材是新鲜的。

examples.en: During the interview, the scientist spoke at length about ocean pollution.
examples.zh: 采访中，这位科学家详细谈论了海洋污染。

examples.en: This lift can carry at most eight passengers.
examples.zh: 这部电梯最多可载八名乘客。

examples.en: At no time should medicine be left where children can reach it.
examples.zh: 任何时候都不应把药放在儿童够得着的地方。

examples.en: At one time, people here paid for bus rides with coins.
examples.zh: 这里的人们曾经用硬币支付公交车费。

examples.en: The factory increased production at the cost of workers’ health.
examples.zh: 这家工厂以工人的健康为代价提高了产量。

examples.en: At the least, wear a helmet if you cycle through busy streets.
examples.zh: 如果你骑车穿过繁忙街道，至少要戴头盔。

examples.en: My grandfather lives alone but stays with us at times.
examples.zh: 我爷爷独自生活，但有时会和我们住在一起。

examples.en: An ambulance passed us at great speed on the highway.
examples.zh: 一辆救护车在高速公路上飞快地超过了我们。

examples.en: Two nurses attended on the injured traveler throughout the night.
examples.zh: 两名护士整夜照料那位受伤的旅客。

examples.en: Eva attributes her clear pronunciation to years of listening practice.
examples.zh: 伊娃把自己清晰的发音归功于多年的听力练习。

examples.en: If anyone questions your figures, these receipts will back you up.
examples.zh: 如果有人质疑你的数据，这些收据会支持你。

examples.en: The director based the film on a true story from his hometown.
examples.zh: 导演根据家乡的一个真实故事拍摄了这部电影。

examples.en: After the repair, wheelchair users will be able to enter the hall easily.
examples.zh: 维修后，轮椅使用者将能够轻松进入大厅。

examples.en: I was about to leave the office when the client called.
examples.zh: 客户打来电话时，我正要离开办公室。

examples.en: Having lived near the station for years, we are accustomed to the noise.
examples.zh: 在车站附近住了多年，我们已经习惯了这种噪音。

examples.en: In some studies, long screen time is associated with poor sleep.
examples.zh: 在一些研究中，长时间看屏幕与睡眠不佳有关。

examples.en: Are you aware of the risks of sharing passwords online?
examples.zh: 你知道在网上分享密码的风险吗？

examples.en: This simple app is capable of translating signs within seconds.
examples.zh: 这个简单的应用程序能在几秒内翻译标牌。

examples.en: We were caught in a sudden shower halfway across the park.
examples.zh: 走到公园半路时，我们遇上了一场突如其来的阵雨。

examples.en: Our university is committed to reducing plastic waste on campus.
examples.zh: 我们大学致力于减少校园里的塑料垃圾。

examples.en: Because of road repairs, bus service is confined to the eastern district.
examples.zh: 由于道路维修，公交服务仅限于东部城区。

examples.en: Photography is restricted to the ground floor of the gallery.
examples.zh: 这家美术馆只允许在一楼拍照。

examples.en: A small team is dedicated to protecting the ancient wall.
examples.zh: 一个小团队专门致力于保护这堵古墙。

examples.en: Much of the weekend was devoted to preparing for Monday’s exam.
examples.zh: 周末的大部分时间都用来准备星期一的考试了。

examples.en: Questions about fees should be directed to the student office.
examples.zh: 有关费用的问题应提交给学生办公室。

examples.en: As a child, Omar was drawn to maps of distant countries.
examples.zh: 小时候，奥马尔就被遥远国家的地图所吸引。

examples.en: The match was canceled, but the change was due to bad weather.
examples.zh: 比赛取消了，但这一变动是由恶劣天气造成的。

meaning: 暴露在...下，处在...的作用之下；

examples.en: Workers in that laboratory may be exposed to harmful chemicals.
examples.zh: 那个实验室的工作人员可能会接触有害化学品。

examples.en: My aunt is fond of collecting postcards from small towns.
examples.zh: 我姑姑喜欢收集小镇的明信片。

examples.en: After the summer rain, the garden was full of color.
examples.zh: 夏雨过后，花园里色彩斑斓。

examples.en: Checking the news before breakfast had become habitual to him.
examples.zh: 早餐前查看新闻已经成了他的习惯。

examples.en: Everything appears to be in order, so the event can begin.
examples.zh: 一切似乎都安排妥当了，因此活动可以开始。

examples.en: More than fifty students are involved in the tree-planting project.
examples.zh: 五十多名学生参与了植树项目。

examples.en: I avoid being involved with companies that ignore environmental rules.
examples.zh: 我避免与无视环保规定的公司有牵连。

examples.en: The final choice of music was left to the dance teacher.
examples.zh: 最后选择什么音乐由舞蹈老师决定。

examples.en: Because seats are limited to thirty, please register early.
examples.zh: 由于座位限于三十个，请尽早报名。

examples.en: High stress can be linked with frequent headaches.
examples.zh: 压力过大可能与频繁头痛有关。

examples.en: Seeing her photograph in the newspaper made the young athlete proud of herself.
examples.zh: 在报纸上看到自己的照片，让这名年轻运动员为自己感到骄傲。

examples.en: In class, this period is often referred to as the golden age of drama.
examples.zh: 课堂上，这一时期常被称为戏剧的黄金时代。

examples.en: The rise in online shopping is closely related to faster delivery services.
examples.zh: 网上购物的增长与更快的配送服务密切相关。

examples.en: By Friday, everyone was sick of eating the same sandwiches.
examples.zh: 到了星期五，大家都吃腻了同样的三明治。

examples.en: All outdoor activities are subject to changes in the weather.
examples.zh: 所有户外活动都可能因天气变化而调整。

examples.en: These light shoes are suitable for walking around the old town.
examples.zh: 这双轻便的鞋适合在古城里步行。

examples.en: Before sending the email, be sure of the address.
examples.zh: 发送邮件前，要确认地址无误。

examples.en: Breakfast is free, with a city map thrown in.
examples.zh: 早餐免费，还附送一张城市地图。

examples.en: The boxes were tied with strong rope before being loaded.
examples.zh: 这些箱子在装车前用结实的绳子捆好了。

examples.en: The success of local shops is tied to the number of tourists.
examples.zh: 当地商店的生意与游客数量密切相关。

examples.en: Tired of waiting indoors, the children went out to play.
examples.zh: 孩子们厌倦了在室内等待，便出去玩了。

examples.en: Our flight arrived behind time because of thick fog.
examples.zh: 由于大雾，我们的航班晚点到达。

meaning: 对...的真实性或正确性具有的信心

examples.en: Her belief in lifelong learning led her back to college at forty.
examples.zh: 她对终身学习的信念使她四十岁时重返大学。

examples.en: Experts believe the vase to be more than five hundred years old.
examples.zh: 专家认为这个花瓶已有五百多年的历史。

examples.en: For short journeys, cycling is often better than driving.
examples.zh: 短途出行时，骑自行车往往比开车更好。

examples.en: Her honesty in returning the wallet is beyond question.
examples.zh: 她归还钱包的诚信是毋庸置疑的。

examples.en: One branch broke away from the old tree during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，一根树枝从老树上断了下来。

examples.en: Our bus broke down outside a village with no repair shop.
examples.zh: 我们的公交车在一个没有修理店的村庄外抛锚了。

examples.en: Someone broke into the bookshop and stole two computers.
examples.zh: 有人闯入书店，偷走了两台电脑。

examples.en: “That date is wrong,” Mei broke in before I finished.
examples.zh: “那个日期错了，”我还没说完，梅就插话道。

examples.en: Talks broke off when neither side would change its price.
examples.zh: 由于双方都不肯改变价格，谈判中断了。

examples.en: A fire broke out in the kitchen, but nobody was hurt.
examples.zh: 厨房发生了火灾，但无人受伤。

examples.en: A research team hopes to break through the language barrier with new software.
examples.zh: 一个研究团队希望用新软件突破语言障碍。

examples.en: The outdoor concert broke up shortly after midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜过后不久，露天音乐会便散场了。

examples.en: Better public transport could bring about cleaner air in the city.
examples.zh: 更好的公共交通可以使城市空气更清洁。

examples.en: The professor brought forward a practical plan for saving energy.
examples.zh: 教授提出了一个切实可行的节能方案。

examples.en: Soft morning light brings out the warm colors in this painting.
examples.zh: 柔和的晨光使这幅画的暖色更加突出。

examples.en: Whenever food safety is discussed, my father brings up farm chemicals.
examples.zh: 每当讨论食品安全时，我父亲都会提到农用化学品。

examples.en: By accident, I left my umbrella in the campus gym.
examples.zh: 我不小心把雨伞落在了校园体育馆。

examples.en: “May I borrow your dictionary?” “By all means.”
examples.zh: “我可以借你的词典吗？”“当然可以。”

examples.en: While changing trains in Suzhou, I met an old neighbor by chance.
examples.zh: 在苏州换乘火车时，我偶然遇到了一位老邻居。

examples.en: Rui lives without a television by choice, not because she cannot afford one.
examples.zh: 睿自愿过着没有电视的生活，并不是因为买不起。

examples.en: City rents rose last year; by contrast, prices in nearby villages fell.
examples.zh: 去年城市房租上涨；相比之下，附近村庄的价格下降了。

examples.en: The cave can be reached only by means of a narrow path.
examples.zh: 只有通过一条狭窄的小路才能到达这个洞穴。

examples.en: I picked up someone else’s suitcase by mistake at the station.
examples.zh: 我在车站误拿了别人的手提箱。

examples.en: By the way, have you returned the novel to the library?
examples.zh: 顺便问一下，你把那本小说还给图书馆了吗？

examples.en: By virtue of her calm manner, the guide gained everyone’s trust.
examples.zh: 凭借沉着的举止，导游赢得了大家的信任。

examples.en: We flew to Rome by way of Istanbul to save money.
examples.zh: 为了省钱，我们经伊斯坦布尔飞往罗马。

examples.en: The graduation song called forth memories of our first day at college.
examples.zh: 毕业歌唤起了我们大学第一天的回忆。

examples.en: Solving the water shortage calls for cooperation across the region.
examples.zh: 解决缺水问题需要整个地区的合作。

examples.en: Since lightning was approaching, the school called off the football match.
examples.zh: 由于闪电逼近，学校取消了足球比赛。

examples.en: At the meeting, the principal called upon students to save water.
examples.zh: 会上，校长号召学生节约用水。

examples.en: Who will care for your cat while you are abroad?
examples.zh: 你在国外期间谁来照顾你的猫？

examples.en: Next month, the class will carry out a survey of reading habits.
examples.zh: 下个月，全班将开展一项阅读习惯调查。

examples.en: These old letters cast light on daily life a century ago.
examples.zh: 这些旧信件使人们了解一百年前的日常生活。

examples.en: By studying during lunch, Dan caught up with the rest of his class.
examples.zh: 丹利用午饭时间学习，赶上了班里的其他同学。

examples.en: Turning the corner, I caught sight of the sea for the first time.
examples.zh: 转过街角时，我第一次看见了大海。

examples.en: Tonight’s campus debate centers on the future of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 今晚的校园辩论以人工智能的未来为中心。

examples.en: The northern winter is characterized by long nights and strong winds.
examples.zh: 北方的冬天以长夜和大风为特征。

examples.en: This year’s art festival will coincide with the university’s anniversary.
examples.zh: 今年的艺术节将与校庆同期举行。

examples.en: Much of the plastic in the ocean comes from waste on land.
examples.zh: 海洋中的许多塑料来自陆地垃圾。

examples.en: Despite the rain, our school play came off remarkably well.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨了，我们的校园话剧还是演得非常成功。

meaning: 涉及，谈及，到达，结束，总共，共计，

examples.en: Come on, or we will miss the opening scene of the film!
examples.zh: 快点，不然我们会错过电影的开场！

examples.en: The truth about the damaged statue eventually came out.
examples.zh: 关于雕像受损的真相最终被揭露了。

meaning: 等于，结果是； 总计，达到

examples.en: After checking the bill twice, the total came to ninety-six yuan.
examples.zh: 把账单核对两遍后，总额为九十六元。

examples.en: The new parking rule came under attack from local shop owners.
examples.zh: 新的停车规定遭到了当地店主的批评。

examples.en: Complaints about dormitory heating come under the housing office.
examples.zh: 有关宿舍供暖的投诉归住宿办公室处理。

examples.en: A question about online privacy came up during the lecture.
examples.zh: 讲座期间有人提出了一个关于网络隐私的问题。

examples.en: Asked to comment on the rumor, the actor smiled and changed the subject.
examples.zh: 当被要求评论传闻时，那位演员笑了笑，换了话题。

examples.en: If you commit to the course, you should attend every workshop.
examples.zh: 如果你承诺参加这门课程，就应该出席每次研讨课。

examples.en: Restaurants must comply with the city’s new food-safety rules.
examples.zh: 餐馆必须遵守该市新的食品安全规定。

examples.en: Does your application photo conform to the stated size requirements?
examples.zh: 你的申请照片符合规定的尺寸要求吗？

examples.en: The tour consists of a boat ride, a farm visit, and lunch.
examples.zh: 这次游览包括乘船、参观农场和午餐。

examples.en: Throughout the semester, Aya was consistent in completing her work early.
examples.zh: 整个学期，阿雅都始终提前完成作业。

examples.en: The witness’s account is consistent with the video from the street camera.
examples.zh: 证人的陈述与街头摄像头的视频一致。

examples.en: Planting trees along busy roads can contribute to cleaner air.
examples.zh: 在繁忙道路两旁植树有助于改善空气质量。

examples.en: Please copy out the poem neatly before tomorrow’s class.
examples.zh: 请在明天上课前把这首诗工整地抄下来。

examples.en: Daily exercise appears to correlate with lower levels of stress.
examples.zh: 日常锻炼似乎与较低的压力水平相关。

examples.en: You can count on the night bus to arrive every half hour.
examples.zh: 你可以相信夜班公交每半小时会来一班。

examples.en: Before building the path, workers cut away the thick bushes.
examples.zh: 修建小路前，工人们砍掉了茂密的灌木。

examples.en: To save electricity, the supermarket has cut down its lighting at night.
examples.zh: 为了节约用电，超市减少了夜间照明。

examples.en: A fallen tree cut off the mountain village from the main road.
examples.zh: 一棵倒下的树切断了山村与主干道的联系。

examples.en: My dentist advised me to cut out sugary drinks for a month.
examples.zh: 牙医建议我一个月内不喝含糖饮料。

examples.en: The doctor dedicated her weekends to serving families in remote areas.
examples.zh: 这位医生把周末时间用于为偏远地区的家庭服务。

examples.en: Whether we picnic tomorrow will depend on the weather.
examples.zh: 我们明天是否野餐将取决于天气。

examples.en: In autumn, the flowers die back but their roots remain alive.
examples.zh: 秋天，花朵枯萎，但根部仍然存活。

examples.en: The noise from the street did not die down until midnight.
examples.zh: 街上的喧闹声直到午夜才渐渐平息。

examples.en: Without enough rain, young trees may die off one by one.
examples.zh: 没有足够的雨水，幼树可能会一棵接一棵地死去。

examples.en: Unless it is taught to children, this local song may die out.
examples.zh: 除非把这首地方歌曲教给孩子们，否则它可能会失传。

examples.en: We noticed a clear difference in air quality after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工厂关闭后，我们注意到空气质量有了明显差异。

examples.en: A few colorful cushions would do a lot for this plain room.
examples.zh: 几个彩色靠垫会让这个朴素的房间增色不少。

examples.en: There is little doubt about the value of learning basic first aid.
examples.zh: 学习基本急救知识的价值几乎是毋庸置疑的。

examples.en: Due to a signal problem, the subway stopped between two stations.
examples.zh: 由于信号问题，地铁停在了两站之间。

examples.en: Rather than dwell on her mistake, Zoe prepared for the next interview.
examples.zh: 佐伊没有老想着自己的错误，而是为下一次面试做准备。

examples.en: Three classmates entered for the national public-speaking contest.
examples.zh: 三名同学报名参加了全国演讲比赛。

examples.en: Before entering into a rental agreement, read every page carefully.
examples.zh: 签订租赁协议前，要仔细阅读每一页。

examples.en: At first the manager would not entertain a proposal to shorten working hours.
examples.zh: 起初，经理不愿考虑缩短工时的提议。

examples.en: For a moment, I entertained the idea of studying abroad.
examples.zh: 有那么一会儿，我考虑过出国留学。

examples.en: Even if the shop is closed, we can order the medicine online.
examples.zh: 即使商店关门了，我们也可以在网上订药。

examples.en: Even though her ankle hurt, Lin finished the charity walk.
examples.zh: 尽管脚踝疼，林还是完成了慈善步行。

meaning: 自从...之后，从此以后)表时间；

examples.en: Ever since I joined the choir, Mondays have felt more cheerful.
examples.zh: 自从我加入合唱团以来，星期一变得更愉快了。

examples.en: The film is faithful to the spirit of the original novel.
examples.zh: 这部电影忠实于原著的精神。

examples.en: Temperatures may fall from twenty degrees to ten overnight.
examples.zh: 气温可能在一夜之间从二十度降到十度。

examples.en: The guesthouse was far from luxurious, but it felt like home.
examples.zh: 这家旅馆远谈不上豪华，但感觉像家一样。

examples.en: Most parents at the meeting spoke in favor of longer library hours.
examples.zh: 会上，大多数家长发言支持延长图书馆开放时间。

examples.en: Using the subway map, we figured out how to reach the science museum.
examples.zh: 我们借助地铁图弄清了去科学博物馆的路线。

examples.en: Call this number to find out whether your passport is ready.
examples.zh: 拨打这个号码，查询你的护照是否办好。

examples.en: Instead of memorizing every detail, focus on the main argument.
examples.zh: 不要记住每个细节，要把注意力集中在主要论点上。

examples.en: A brief introduction was followed by questions from the audience.
examples.zh: 简短的介绍之后是观众提问。

examples.en: For all his experience, the driver still felt nervous on the icy road.
examples.zh: 尽管经验丰富，这名司机在结冰的路上仍感到紧张。

examples.en: Some daily habits save energy; for example, turning off unused lights helps.
examples.zh: 一些日常习惯可以节能，例如关掉不用的灯就有帮助。

meaning: 和 such as 都表示举例，前者常接句子，后者常接名词或名词短语；例如

examples.en: Several campus services, for instance the health center, remain open in summer.
examples.zh: 几项校园服务，例如健康中心，暑假期间仍然开放。

examples.en: The room was reserved for the purpose of holding student interviews.
examples.zh: 这个房间被预留用于进行学生面试。

examples.en: For the sake of her eyes, Keira takes a break from the screen each hour.
examples.zh: 为了保护眼睛，凯拉每小时都会离开屏幕休息一下。

examples.en: Frankly speaking, this fashionable jacket is not worth the price.
examples.zh: 坦率地说，这件时髦的夹克不值这个价钱。

examples.en: A quiet weekend in the countryside offered freedom from city noise.
examples.zh: 在乡村度过一个安静的周末，让人摆脱了城市噪音。

meaning: 从所能见到和知道的情况判断

examples.en: From all appearances, the little bookstore is doing good business.
examples.zh: 从种种迹象看，这家小书店生意不错。

examples.en: Encouragement came from all sides after her first article was published.
examples.zh: 她的第一篇文章发表后，各方面都给予了鼓励。

examples.en: From now on, household waste must be placed in separate bins.
examples.zh: 从现在起，生活垃圾必须放入不同的垃圾桶。

examples.en: By all accounts, the island is most beautiful in early autumn.
examples.zh: 据大家所说，这座岛在初秋最美。

examples.en: As the bell rang, the children gathered up their sports equipment.
examples.zh: 铃声响起时，孩子们收拾起了运动器材。

examples.en: Generally speaking, fresh food contains less salt than packaged meals.
examples.zh: 一般来说，新鲜食物比包装食品含盐更少。

examples.en: Although they share a tiny kitchen, the four roommates get along with one another.
examples.zh: 尽管共用一个小厨房，四名室友相处得很好。

examples.en: We left the crowded beach early to get away from the noise.
examples.zh: 我们早早离开拥挤的海滩，以远离喧闹。

examples.en: With the guests seated, the host got down to explaining the game.
examples.zh: 客人坐好后，主人开始认真讲解游戏规则。

examples.en: The key would not turn, so I could not get in.
examples.zh: 钥匙转不动，所以我进不去。

examples.en: Under growing pressure from customers, the company finally gave in.
examples.zh: 在顾客日益增大的压力下，公司终于让步了。

examples.en: These kitchen plants give off a pleasant smell after watering.
examples.zh: 这些厨房植物浇水后会散发出宜人的气味。

examples.en: Halfway up the hill, our water supplies began to give out.
examples.zh: 走到半山腰时，我们的饮用水开始用完了。

examples.en: One careless comment gave away the ending of the movie.
examples.zh: 一句不经意的评论泄露了电影的结局。

examples.en: Never give up simply because progress seems slow.
examples.zh: 绝不要仅仅因为进展缓慢就放弃。

examples.en: After hours of heavy rain, the old bridge gave way.
examples.zh: 连续下了几个小时的大雨后，那座老桥坍塌了。

examples.en: Learning a language goes beyond remembering lists of words.
examples.zh: 学习一门语言不只是记忆单词表。

examples.en: As the weeks went by, I became more confident at work.
examples.zh: 随着一周周过去，我在工作中变得更自信了。

examples.en: Given the sunny forecast, let us go for a hike on Sunday.
examples.zh: 既然天气预报说是晴天，我们星期天去远足吧。

examples.en: When the alarm sounded, a firefighter went in to search the building.
examples.zh: 警报响起时，一名消防员进入大楼搜查。

examples.en: Anyone starting a new job goes through a period of adjustment.
examples.zh: 任何开始新工作的人都会经历一段适应期。

examples.en: Please hand these safety tips on to the next group of visitors.
examples.zh: 请把这些安全提示传给下一组游客。

examples.en: At the station entrance, volunteers were handing out city maps.
examples.zh: 在车站入口处，志愿者们正在分发城市地图。

examples.en: Before retiring, the shop owner handed the business over to her daughter.
examples.zh: 退休前，店主把生意移交给了女儿。

examples.en: The time of departure may have a bearing on the price of your ticket.
examples.zh: 出发时间可能会影响你的票价。

examples.en: Mina has difficulty with spoken English when people talk quickly.
examples.zh: 别人说得很快时，米娜听说英语有困难。

examples.en: Fear of failure should not hold you back from trying again.
examples.zh: 对失败的恐惧不应阻止你再次尝试。

examples.en: The café uses smaller menus to hold down printing costs.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆使用较小的菜单来控制印刷成本。

examples.en: Even after moving abroad, Leo held on to his childhood dream.
examples.zh: 即使移居国外，利奥仍坚持儿时的梦想。

examples.en: Hold on while I check whether the doctor is free.
examples.zh: 请稍等，我看看医生是否有空。

examples.en: Our food supplies will hold out until the rescue team arrives.
examples.zh: 我们的食物储备能维持到救援队到达。

meaning: 保持良好，停止；阻滞；举起，承载，阻挡

examples.en: Heavy snow held up several trains outside the city.
examples.zh: 大雪耽搁了城外的几趟列车。

examples.en: If only I had brought an umbrella this morning!
examples.zh: 要是我今天早上带了伞就好了！

examples.en: This printer is still in use despite its age.
examples.zh: 这台打印机虽然用了很久，却仍在使用。

examples.en: The two solutions differ in some degree, but both are practical.
examples.zh: 这两种解决办法在某种程度上不同，但都很实用。

meaning: 从某种意义上说)它可以放在句首、句中或者句尾，一般不用逗号隔开；

examples.en: In a sense, losing that match taught us how to cooperate.
examples.zh: 从某种意义上说，输掉那场比赛教会了我们如何合作。

examples.en: After the earthquake, many families lived in a state of fear.
examples.zh: 地震后，许多家庭生活在恐惧之中。

examples.en: Working from home has, in a way, brought us closer.
examples.zh: 居家办公从某种角度来说让我们更亲近了。

examples.en: The new school rules are in accord with parents' wishes.
examples.zh: 新的校规符合家长们的意愿。

examples.en: In addition to milk, the recipe requires two eggs.
examples.zh: 除了牛奶，这个食谱还需要两个鸡蛋。

examples.en: There were thirty guests in all at Nora's birthday dinner.
examples.zh: 诺拉的生日晚餐总共有三十位客人。

examples.en: The bus may be late; in any case, we have enough time.
examples.zh: 公交车可能晚点；无论如何，我们有足够的时间。

examples.en: In case of fire, leave the building by the stairs.
examples.zh: 万一发生火灾，请从楼梯离开大楼。

examples.en: Take some water in case the walk lasts longer than expected.
examples.zh: 带些水吧，以防步行时间比预想的长。

meaning: 在原地兜圈子，毫无进展

examples.en: Without clear leadership, the talks went in circles for hours.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏明确的领导，谈判几小时都毫无进展。

examples.en: The road was flooded; in consequence, classes were canceled.
examples.zh: 道路被淹，因此课程取消了。

examples.en: When in doubt, ask the librarian where to find the book.
examples.zh: 有疑问时，就问图书管理员去哪里找这本书。

meaning: 实质上，实际上)它在句中一般不需要用逗号隔开；

examples.en: The price cut is in effect a warm welcome to new customers.
examples.zh: 这次降价实际上是对新顾客的一种热情欢迎。

examples.en: Though their customs differ, the two festivals are in essence alike.
examples.zh: 尽管习俗不同，这两个节日本质上是相似的。

examples.en: I thought the bag was leather, but in fact it was plastic.
examples.zh: 我以为这个包是皮的，但实际上它是塑料的。

examples.en: "Please return to your seats," the guide said in a firm voice.
examples.zh: “请回到座位上，”导游用坚定的声音说道。

meaning: 总的来说，大体上；一般来说：

examples.en: In general, fresh vegetables contain more vitamins than canned ones.
examples.zh: 一般来说，新鲜蔬菜比罐装蔬菜含有更多维生素。

examples.en: Her daily actions are in line with her promise to save energy.
examples.zh: 她每天的行动符合她节约能源的承诺。

examples.en: The designer had young families in mind when creating the chairs.
examples.zh: 设计师设计这些椅子时考虑的是年轻家庭。

examples.en: After years without repairs, the bridge is in need of attention.
examples.zh: 多年未修后，这座桥需要维护。

examples.en: This small mistake in no way reduces the value of your work.
examples.zh: 这个小错误决不会降低你工作的价值。

examples.en: In my opinion, public parks make cities more pleasant.
examples.zh: 在我看来，公共公园让城市更宜居。

examples.en: In a child's terms, the scientist explained why stars shine.
examples.zh: 这位科学家用孩子能懂的话解释了星星为什么发光。

examples.en: A fallen bicycle was in the way of passing cars.
examples.zh: 一辆倒下的自行车挡住了过往车辆。

examples.en: Ella left early in order to catch the first subway.
examples.zh: 埃拉早早离开，以便赶上首班地铁。

examples.en: Before the guests arrive, please put the cups in order.
examples.zh: 客人到来之前，请把杯子摆放整齐。

examples.en: Kai enjoys outdoor sports, hiking in particular.
examples.zh: 凯喜欢户外运动，尤其喜欢徒步旅行。

meaning: 关系恰当地，观察合理地；

examples.en: Talking to the nurse put my minor injury in perspective.
examples.zh: 和护士交谈后，我对自己的轻伤有了恰当的认识。

examples.en: In point of safety, the newer route is clearly better.
examples.zh: 说到安全性，新路线显然更好。

meaning: 对...表示 怀疑，有疑问

examples.en: The painting in question was created by a local student.
examples.zh: 所谈到的那幅画是一名当地学生创作的。

examples.en: I am writing in reference to your advertisement for a tutor.
examples.zh: 我写信是想咨询你们招聘家教的广告。

examples.en: Several residents spoke in regard to the proposed night market.
examples.zh: 几位居民就拟建的夜市发表了意见。

examples.en: The study examines sleep in relation to memory.
examples.zh: 这项研究考察睡眠与记忆之间的关系。

examples.en: In reply to my email, the hotel offered another room.
examples.zh: 作为对我邮件的回复，酒店提供了另一个房间。

meaning: 作为对...的回答，作为对...的反应；

examples.en: Prices fell in response to weaker demand for winter coats.
examples.zh: 由于冬衣需求减弱，价格随之下降。

examples.en: We gave our neighbor fresh bread in return for her help.
examples.zh: 为了答谢邻居的帮助，我们送给她新鲜面包。

examples.en: In short, the plan is affordable, simple, and useful.
examples.zh: 简言之，这个计划经济、简单而且实用。

examples.en: In spite of the cold wind, the children finished the race.
examples.zh: 尽管寒风凛冽，孩子们还是完成了比赛。

examples.en: In terms of comfort, this old sofa is hard to beat.
examples.zh: 从舒适度来说，这张旧沙发很难被超越。

examples.en: A small error emerged in the analysis of the survey data.
examples.zh: 在分析调查数据时出现了一个小错误。

examples.en: The apartment is cheap and, in the bargain, close to my office.
examples.zh: 这套公寓价格便宜，而且还离我的办公室很近。

examples.en: In the case of online orders, payment must be made first.
examples.zh: 就网上订单而言，必须先付款。

examples.en: Children often feel safer in the company of familiar adults.
examples.zh: 孩子们有熟悉的成年人陪伴时通常会更有安全感。

examples.en: She met several inspiring teachers in the course of her studies.
examples.zh: 她在求学期间遇到了几位鼓舞人心的老师。

examples.en: After considering three offers, Jamal chose the smallest firm in the end.
examples.zh: 在考虑了三份工作邀请后，贾马尔最终选择了最小的公司。

examples.en: In the event of rain, the concert will move indoors.
examples.zh: 万一下雨，音乐会将移到室内举行。

examples.en: The artist presented local history in the form of a comic book.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家以漫画书的形式呈现当地历史。

examples.en: In the light of recent complaints, the store extended its opening hours.
examples.zh: 鉴于最近的投诉，商店延长了营业时间。

examples.en: We learned patience in the process of caring for the injured bird.
examples.zh: 在照料受伤小鸟的过程中，我们学会了耐心。

examples.en: With regular practice, your pronunciation will improve in time.
examples.zh: 通过经常练习，你的发音最终会提高。

examples.en: Each runner carried the flag in turn around the field.
examples.zh: 每位赛跑者依次举着旗帜绕过操场。

examples.en: For an hour, I searched in vain for my missing key.
examples.zh: 我徒劳地找了一个小时，仍没找到丢失的钥匙。

examples.en: The village was destroyed in whole by the sudden flood.
examples.zh: 这个村庄被突如其来的洪水彻底摧毁了。

examples.en: Good teachers infuse confidence into nervous learners.
examples.zh: 优秀的老师会给紧张的学习者注入信心。

examples.en: My grandfather insists on walking to the market every morning.
examples.zh: 我爷爷坚持每天早晨步行去市场。

examples.en: Instead of blaming each other, let us find a solution.
examples.zh: 与其互相责怪，不如让我们找个解决办法。

examples.en: Her interest in photography began during a family trip.
examples.zh: 她对摄影的兴趣始于一次家庭旅行。

examples.en: The rule applies to every passenger, irrespective of age.
examples.zh: 这条规定适用于每位乘客，不论年龄。

examples.en: Thick curtains isolate the bedroom from street noise.
examples.zh: 厚窗帘使卧室免受街道噪声的干扰。

examples.en: It used to be difficult to buy fresh fruit here in winter.
examples.zh: 过去冬天在这里很难买到新鲜水果。

examples.en: Seeing everyone dance, Ruth gladly joined in.
examples.zh: 看到大家都在跳舞，露丝高兴地加入了。

examples.en: Our coach lays emphasis on teamwork rather than individual fame.
examples.zh: 我们的教练强调团队合作，而不是个人名声。

examples.en: It is unfair to put the blame on one careless worker.
examples.zh: 把责任归咎于一名粗心的工人是不公平的。

examples.en: A cheerful song will lead off tonight's school performance.
examples.zh: 一首欢快的歌曲将为今晚的校园演出开场。

examples.en: The narrow path led us on through a field of yellow flowers.
examples.zh: 狭窄的小路继续引领我们穿过一片黄色花田。

examples.en: A guide led the visitors out through a quiet side door.
examples.zh: 一名向导带领游客从安静的侧门出去。

examples.en: Too little sleep can lead to poor concentration.
examples.zh: 睡眠太少会导致注意力不集中。

examples.en: The repair took less than an hour.
examples.zh: 这次修理用了不到一个小时。

examples.en: A shared love of music linked the two strangers together.
examples.zh: 对音乐共同的热爱把两个陌生人联系在一起。

examples.en: Long before sunrise, fishing boats had left the harbor.
examples.zh: 早在日出之前，渔船就已驶离港口。

examples.en: We cannot simply look on while the river becomes polluted.
examples.zh: 我们不能在河流受到污染时只是袖手旁观。

examples.en: Despite a higher salary elsewhere, Ava remained loyal to her team.
examples.zh: 尽管别处薪水更高，艾娃仍忠于自己的团队。

examples.en: By apologizing sincerely, he made a step toward peace.
examples.zh: 通过真诚道歉，他朝和解迈出了一步。

examples.en: Wide windows make for a bright and welcoming classroom.
examples.zh: 宽大的窗户有助于营造明亮宜人的教室。

examples.en: Through the crowd, the nurse made her way to the injured man.
examples.zh: 护士穿过人群，走向那名受伤的男子。

meaning: 弄懂；辨认，开出(支票，药方等)

examples.en: From the hilltop, we could just make out the distant tower.
examples.zh: 从山顶上，我们勉强能辨认出远处的塔。

examples.en: Make sure the windows are closed before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前务必确认窗户已经关好。

examples.en: Hearing her name, the passenger made towards the front desk.
examples.zh: 听到自己的名字，那名乘客朝前台走去。

examples.en: People quickly made way for the approaching ambulance.
examples.zh: 人们迅速为驶来的救护车让路。

examples.en: What do you mean by calling the task impossible?
examples.zh: 你说这项任务不可能是什么意思？

examples.en: The lecture was more amusing than informative.
examples.zh: 这场讲座与其说信息丰富，不如说很有趣。

examples.en: Volunteering offers more than a chance to meet people.
examples.zh: 志愿服务提供的不只是结识他人的机会。

examples.en: Much as I respect Ben, I cannot accept his argument.
examples.zh: 尽管我尊重本，但我无法接受他的观点。

examples.en: The rescue required no less courage than skill.
examples.zh: 这次救援既需要技巧，也同样需要勇气。

examples.en: A fish can no more live without water than we can live without air.
examples.zh: 鱼离不开水，正如我们离不开空气。

examples.en: The noise came not from the street but from upstairs.
examples.zh: 噪声不是来自街上，而是来自楼上。

examples.en: Now that the rain has stopped, we can continue our picnic.
examples.zh: 既然雨停了，我们可以继续野餐了。

examples.en: Many neighbors objected to cutting down the old trees.
examples.zh: 许多邻居反对砍掉这些老树。

examples.en: Of course, you may borrow my dictionary for the weekend.
examples.zh: 当然，你周末可以借我的词典。

examples.en: The company plans to produce electric bikes on a large scale.
examples.zh: 这家公司计划大规模生产电动自行车。

examples.en: A reading campaign was launched on a national scale.
examples.zh: 一场阅读活动在全国范围内展开。

examples.en: Our flight was delayed on account of thick fog.
examples.zh: 由于浓雾，我们的航班延误了。

examples.en: On average, this battery lasts about ten hours.
examples.zh: 这块电池平均能用大约十小时。

examples.en: On behalf of my classmates, I thanked the visiting writer.
examples.zh: 我代表同学们感谢了来访的作家。

examples.en: Free concerts are held on campus every Friday evening.
examples.zh: 每周五晚上校园里都会举办免费音乐会。

examples.en: My aunt travels for work and stays with us on occasion.
examples.zh: 我姑姑因工作出差，偶尔会住在我们家。

examples.en: The final result was announced on radio before noon.
examples.zh: 最终结果中午前通过广播公布了。

examples.en: On the average, each household uses three bags of rice a month.
examples.zh: 平均而言，每户每月用三袋大米。

examples.en: Scholarships are awarded on the basis of ability and need.
examples.zh: 奖学金根据能力和需求发放。

examples.en: The room is not too small; on the contrary, it feels quite spacious.
examples.zh: 这个房间并不太小；相反，它感觉相当宽敞。

examples.en: He was refused entry on the grounds of safety.
examples.zh: 他以安全为由被拒绝入内。

examples.en: On the occasion of her graduation, Mei received a family watch.
examples.zh: 梅毕业之际，收到了一块家传手表。

examples.en: City life is convenient; on the other hand, it can be stressful.
examples.zh: 城市生活很方便；另一方面，也可能压力很大。

meaning: 通过广播，无线电广播中；

examples.en: I first heard this folk song on the radio.
examples.zh: 我第一次是在广播里听到这首民歌的。

examples.en: During college, Luis repaired bicycles on the side.
examples.zh: 大学期间，路易斯兼职修理自行车。

examples.en: In the debate, Carla stood on the side of local farmers.
examples.zh: 在辩论中，卡拉站在当地农民一边。

examples.en: On the whole, our weekend trip went smoothly.
examples.zh: 总的来看，我们的周末旅行很顺利。

examples.en: Although traffic was heavy, the interview began on time.
examples.zh: 尽管交通拥堵，面试还是准时开始了。

examples.en: Roommates should respect one another's need for quiet.
examples.zh: 室友应该相互尊重彼此对安静环境的需要。

examples.en: One or other of these keys must open the garden gate.
examples.zh: 这两把钥匙中总有一把能打开花园门。

examples.en: You may enter the lab only if a teacher is present.
examples.zh: 只有老师在场时，你才可以进入实验室。

examples.en: No one other than Priya knew the safe password.
examples.zh: 除了普丽娅，没有人知道保险柜的密码。

examples.en: His bright tie looked out of step with the formal meeting.
examples.zh: 他的鲜艳领带与正式会议很不协调。

examples.en: Buying a car is out of the question on my present income.
examples.zh: 以我目前的收入，买车是不可能的。

examples.en: Fax machines have fallen out of use in many offices.
examples.zh: 传真机在许多办公室已经不再使用。

examples.en: I owe my love of books to my primary school teacher.
examples.zh: 我把对书籍的热爱归功于小学老师。

meaning: 分发，分配；昏倒，死去；失去知觉，晕倒；

examples.en: Two students passed out leaflets near the museum entrance.
examples.zh: 两名学生在博物馆入口附近分发传单。

examples.en: The storm passed off without causing serious damage.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过去了，没有造成严重损失。

examples.en: Please pass this message on to anyone who missed class.
examples.zh: 请把这条消息转告给没来上课的人。

examples.en: Cyclists must pay attention to pedestrians at crossings.
examples.zh: 骑车人在路口必须注意行人。

examples.en: We paid by check because the shop did not accept cards.
examples.zh: 因为商店不收银行卡，我们用支票付款。

meaning: 或 pay cash 付现金。

examples.en: At the market, customers often pay in cash.
examples.zh: 在这个市场，顾客经常用现金付款。

examples.en: Months of careful training paid off when Lina won the race.
examples.zh: 数月的认真训练有了回报，莉娜赢得了比赛。

examples.en: Despite several failures, the inventor persisted in his experiments.
examples.zh: 尽管失败了几次，这位发明家仍坚持做实验。

examples.en: On my walk home, I picked up a lost wallet.
examples.zh: 我步行回家时捡到了一个丢失的钱包。

examples.en: It is wise to plan for unexpected travel expenses.
examples.zh: 为意外的旅行开支做计划是明智的。

examples.en: Dark clouds over the hills point to an evening storm.
examples.zh: 山丘上方的乌云预示着傍晚会有暴风雨。

examples.en: Properly speaking, a tomato is a fruit rather than a vegetable.
examples.zh: 严格来说，西红柿是水果而不是蔬菜。

examples.en: You can use my laptop provided that you handle it carefully.
examples.zh: 只要你小心使用，就可以用我的笔记本电脑。

examples.en: Put together, these small changes could save much energy.
examples.zh: 综合起来，这些小改变可以节省大量能源。

examples.en: I cannot put up with loud music after midnight.
examples.zh: 我无法忍受午夜后的吵闹音乐。

examples.en: Her actual experience was quite other than what we had imagined.
examples.zh: 她的实际经历与我们想象的完全不同。

examples.en: Sam chose to cycle rather than wait for the crowded bus.
examples.zh: 萨姆选择骑车，而不是等拥挤的公交车。

examples.en: The term "green energy" refers to power from clean sources.
examples.zh: “绿色能源”一词指来自清洁来源的能源。

examples.en: His rude remarks reflect discredit on the whole organization.
examples.zh: 他的无礼言论使整个组织蒙羞。

examples.en: During the quiet journey, she reflected on her future.
examples.zh: 在安静的旅途中，她思考了自己的未来。

examples.en: Small farms often rely on family members during harvest time.
examples.zh: 小农场在收获季常常依靠家庭成员。

examples.en: The dentist removed a tiny stone from my tooth.
examples.zh: 牙医从我的牙齿里取出了一小块石头。

examples.en: Who is responsible for locking the sports hall tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚谁负责锁体育馆的门？

examples.en: Most kitchen accidents result from carelessness.
examples.zh: 大多数厨房事故源于粗心。

examples.en: Regular exercise can result in better sleep.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼可以带来更好的睡眠。

examples.en: After years of preparation, the town is ripe for change.
examples.zh: 经过多年的准备，这座小镇已具备变革的条件。

examples.en: Police hope to root out the cause of the false alarms.
examples.zh: 警方希望查清这些虚假警报的根源。

examples.en: Anyone climbing alone in winter runs a serious risk.
examples.zh: 任何人在冬季独自登山都会冒很大风险。

examples.en: Never sacrifice your health to short-term success.
examples.zh: 绝不要为了短期成功而牺牲健康。

examples.en: A strong fence secured the garden from animal attack.
examples.zh: 一道坚固的围栏保护花园免受动物袭击。

examples.en: After breakfast, we set about cleaning the beach.
examples.zh: 早餐后，我们开始清理海滩。

examples.en: Nadia sets aside part of her salary for travel.
examples.zh: 纳迪娅把一部分工资留作旅行费用。

examples.en: A broken machine set back production by two days.
examples.zh: 一台坏机器使生产延误了两天。

examples.en: The driver set down the passengers beside the library.
examples.zh: 司机让乘客在图书馆旁下车。

examples.en: In her speech, the doctor set forth three practical suggestions.
examples.zh: 医生在演讲中阐述了三条实用建议。

examples.en: We set off at dawn to avoid the midday heat.
examples.zh: 我们黎明时出发，以避开中午的炎热。

examples.en: Maps and guidebooks were set out on a long table.
examples.zh: 地图和旅游指南陈列在一张长桌上。

examples.en: Would you share your umbrella with the child?
examples.zh: 你愿意和那个孩子共用雨伞吗？

examples.en: The director will shoot a film about life on the island.
examples.zh: 这位导演将拍摄一部关于岛上生活的电影。

examples.en: To everyone's surprise, my brother sided with our neighbor.
examples.zh: 令大家惊讶的是，我哥哥支持了我们的邻居。

examples.en: This teaching method is similar to the one used in Japan.
examples.zh: 这种教学方法与日本使用的方法相似。

examples.en: I moved here in 2022 and have worked nearby since then.
examples.zh: 我在2022年搬到这里，从那时起一直在附近工作。

examples.en: The box weighed something like twenty kilograms.
examples.zh: 这个箱子大约重二十公斤。

examples.en: The package arrived sooner than we had expected.
examples.zh: 包裹比我们预料的更早到达。

examples.en: A second cashier was hired to speed up service.
examples.zh: 店里又雇了一名收银员来加快服务。

examples.en: The red heart on this map stands for the city hospital.
examples.zh: 这张地图上的红心代表市医院。

meaning: 增加，加速 在 ...方面不同。

examples.en: Local factories have stepped up efforts to reduce waste.
examples.zh: 当地工厂加大了减少废物的力度。

examples.en: If you stick to the schedule, the project will finish in May.
examples.zh: 如果你坚持按计划进行，项目将在五月完成。

examples.en: Stimulated by the lively discussion, Chen offered a new idea.
examples.zh: 受到热烈讨论的激励，陈提出了一个新想法。

examples.en: The article stirred up public concern about food safety.
examples.zh: 这篇文章引起了公众对食品安全的担忧。

examples.en: Simple habits, such as turning off lights, can save power.
examples.zh: 关灯等简单习惯可以节约电力。

examples.en: Public support for the new library continues to grow.
examples.zh: 公众对新图书馆的支持持续增加。

examples.en: We expected an empty beach, and sure enough, nobody was there.
examples.zh: 我们料想海滩上没人，果然那里空无一人。

examples.en: Please take away your empty bottles after the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐后请带走你们的空瓶子。

examples.en: The school has taken a step to make lunches healthier.
examples.zh: 学校已采取措施让午餐更加健康。

examples.en: During the sale, shoppers took advantage of lower prices.
examples.zh: 促销期间，购物者利用了较低的价格。

examples.en: Could you take care of my plants while I am away?
examples.zh: 我不在时，你能照料我的植物吗？

examples.en: From a distance, I took the stranger for my uncle.
examples.zh: 从远处看，我把那个陌生人误认为了我叔叔。

examples.en: It took me several minutes to take in the surprising news.
examples.zh: 我花了几分钟才理解这个令人惊讶的消息。

examples.en: At sunset, the lake took on a golden color.
examples.zh: 日落时，湖面呈现出金色。

examples.en: A younger chef will take over the family restaurant next spring.
examples.zh: 明年春天，一位更年轻的厨师将接管这家家庭餐馆。

meaning: 开始喜欢，开始从事，开始沉湎于

examples.en: After one lesson, Pablo quickly took to swimming.
examples.zh: 上了一节课后，巴勃罗很快就喜欢上了游泳。

examples.en: At university, she took up with a group of young actors.
examples.zh: 在大学里，她开始和一群年轻演员来往。

examples.en: Gardening took up most of my Sunday afternoon.
examples.zh: 园艺占用了我星期天下午的大部分时间。

examples.en: Thanks to a stranger's directions, we found the station.
examples.zh: 多亏一位陌生人指路，我们找到了车站。

examples.en: The bulk of the museum's collection came from private gifts.
examples.zh: 博物馆藏品的大部分来自私人捐赠。

examples.en: Tea and coffee are both served here; the former is free, while the latter costs two yuan.
examples.zh: 这里既供应茶也供应咖啡；前者免费，后者两元。

examples.en: To a certain extent, weather influences people's moods.
examples.zh: 天气在一定程度上会影响人们的情绪。

examples.en: The notice serves to caution visitors against feeding the bears.
examples.zh: 这则告示用于警告游客不要给熊喂食。

examples.en: This year's town festival will center around traditional music.
examples.zh: 今年的小镇节日将以传统音乐为中心。

examples.en: Online lessons have changed our study habits to some extent.
examples.zh: 网络课程在某种程度上改变了我们的学习习惯。

examples.en: The room was crowded to such an extent that we could hardly move.
examples.zh: 房间拥挤到了我们几乎无法移动的程度。

examples.en: We trust people to the extent that their actions match their words.
examples.zh: 我们对一个人的信任程度取决于其言行是否一致。

examples.en: Heat can turn ice into water within minutes.
examples.zh: 热量可以在几分钟内把冰变成水。

examples.en: The violinist, together with two dancers, opened the show.
examples.zh: 小提琴手和两名舞者一起为演出开场。

examples.en: The transition to a new school can feel difficult at first.
examples.zh: 刚开始时，向新学校的过渡可能让人感到困难。

examples.en: Unable to watch the injection, Omar turned away.
examples.zh: 奥马尔不敢看打针，便把脸转开了。

examples.en: Turn over the card to read the answer.
examples.zh: 把卡片翻过来就能看到答案。

examples.en: Someone called her name, and she turned round with a smile.
examples.zh: 有人叫她的名字，她微笑着转过身来。

examples.en: Whenever I face a hard choice, I turn to my sister.
examples.zh: 每当面临艰难选择时，我都会向姐姐求助。

examples.en: My missing glove turned up under the car seat.
examples.zh: 我丢失的手套竟在汽车座位下面找到了。

examples.en: The hotel is comfortable; what is more, it faces the sea.
examples.zh: 这家酒店很舒适，而且面朝大海。

examples.en: With regard to your request, I will send the details tomorrow.
examples.zh: 关于你的请求，我明天会发送详细信息。

examples.en: "Meet me outside at six," he said, and with that he left.
examples.zh: “六点在外面见我，”他说罢便离开了。

examples.en: With the exception of one rainy morning, our holiday was sunny.
examples.zh: 除一个下雨的早晨外，我们假期里都是晴天。

examples.en: The train crossed the open plain with surprising speed.
examples.zh: 火车以惊人的速度穿过了开阔的平原。

examples.en: While others chatted, Iris worked away at her model plane.
examples.zh: 别人聊天时，艾丽丝一直在制作她的模型飞机。

examples.en: Can you work out how much each person should pay?
examples.zh: 你能算出每个人应该付多少钱吗？

examples.en: Before the speech, I walked around to work up my confidence.
examples.zh: 演讲前，我四处走动以逐步建立信心。

examples.en: Ignoring the leak would be worse than paying for repairs now.
examples.zh: 忽视漏水问题会比现在花钱维修更糟。

examples.en: All afternoon, the novelist wrote away beside the window.
examples.zh: 整个下午，这位小说家都在窗边不停地写作。

examples.en: Several listeners wrote in to request a repeat of the program.
examples.zh: 几位听众写信要求重播这个节目。

examples.en: The garage wrote off the damaged van after the crash.
examples.zh: 事故后，修车厂把受损的货车作了报废处理。

meaning: 就…… 撰文、围绕…… 来写，记述

examples.en: For the school magazine, Hana wrote on the value of friendship.
examples.zh: 哈娜为校刊撰文讨论友谊的价值。
